integrity: An analytic, same-model-reviewed theorem with a self-contained stationary-generator derivation and a replayable finite checker; no independent audit or validation has occurred. The primary source’s full stationary characteristic function already implies equal-time moments; new scope is ordered two-time squared-mode regressions and global sign classification.
scientific_limitations: Equal thermal noise, stable positive coupling below one, complete simultaneous Poisson resets to an independent uniform circle mark, positive circle radius, stationary process. A vanishing fourth-order diagnostic does not establish reversibility or zero entropy production. General initial distributions, partial resetting, nonuniform marks, nonlinear dynamics and unequal bath intensities are not covered.
title: A fourth-order time-arrow reversal under circular resetting of coupled harmonic modes
